messages:
emma_support: FYI — ACME reporting 429s even though Console shows ~80% quota remaining for org acme-prod. They hit it around 09:22 UTC. Request ids: r=abc123, r=def456. Customer on support call now. Can someone triage? :grimacing:

kevin_sre: I can take a look. Can you paste full request-id and any response headers? Also which env (prod/dedicated)?

emma_support: Prod. Example curl they sent:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Request-ID: abc123" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response: 429 with headers:
```
X-Quota-Remaining: 5000
X-Quota-Window-End: 1700000000
X-Request-ID: abc123
```

lina_engineering: Hmm console shows 5k left because the UI reads the minute-aggregates from metrics-store (per-minute rollup). Enforcer uses sliding 60s window from realtime stream. If there's a lag in the stream consumer for this tenant, UI can be stale while enforcer is accurate.

kevin_sre: Checking consumer group for quota-aggregator: `consumer:quota-agg-prod` — I see partition 17 lag=42k for tenant acme-prod. Also saw this error in aggregator logs right after last deploy:
```
2026-02-28T09:20:12Z ERROR aggregator.partition-17 KeyError: 'window_end' (consumer.v1.14.0 -> aggregator.v2.3)
```

emma_support: Is this a recent deployment? Customer says issue started ~09:15 UTC.

lina_engineering: Yes, we rolled aggregator v2.3 @09:10 to address another bug. Looks like a schema assumption changed: upstream metrics had optional `window_end` removed in KStream message for single-token bursts. Aggregator crash causes lag and missing minute rollups, so UI shows old snapshot while enforcer continues processing some live tokens — but because aggregator didn't commit, enforcer falls back to strict counts and hits the limit.

jordan_product: Impacted customers list? How many tenants on partition 17?

kevin_sre: Partition 17 has ~120 tenants; only ones with burst patterns hit the enforcement mismatch. ACME is high-volume so they surfaced first. I'm patching aggregator to handle missing `window_end` — will deploy hotfix to revert to tolerant parsing.

lina_engineering: Quick mitigation: trigger a one-off replay of the aggregator consumer for partition 17 from offset -100k to force rebuild of minute rollups for affected tenants. Command:
```
./tools/consumer-replay --group consumer:quota-agg-prod --partition 17 --start-offset 12345000 --end-offset latest
```
This will catch up UI snapshots within ~3-5m.

kevin_sre: Hotfix is ready (v2.3.1) and green in staging. I'll rollout to prod with canary to partition 17 first. Expected ETA 20m. After deploy I'll run the replay.

emma_support: I'll update ACME on the call: saying we identified ingestion parsing bug in metrics aggregator, rolling fix + replay, expected console consistency in ~30 minutes. Any customer-level workaround we can advise?

lina_engineering: For now, users can use the `X-Quota-Remaining` header in responses (if present) as authoritative. If they need immediate unblocking, we can temporarily bump their quota or whitelist their API key — coordinate with sales/billing.

kevin_sre: Action items:
- Deploy aggregator v2.3.1 to prod canary partition 17 (me)
- Run consumer-replay for partition 17 after canary success (me)
- Monitor enforcer 429 rates and UI rollups (lina)
- Customer comms and follow-up (emma)

emma_support: Thanks all. Logging notes into the ticket #CASE-4821 and will post update in 15m.

quota-bot: notifier: case CASE-4821 updated by emma_support — status: investigating

emma_support: Update: hotfix deployed to canary, replay started. I'll ping when console matches enforcer. :thumbsup:
